title: Special Executive Programme In Strategic Management
description: Gain essential insights into strategic management and competitive advantage to drive operational success.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme covers the critical elements of strategy formulation, competitive analysis, and strategic planning. Participants will explore tools like SWOT, Porter’s Five Forces, and value chain analysis to enhance decision-making and competitive positioning.
courseDetails: Participants will delve into the core concepts of strategy, understanding its importance in organizational success and sustainability. The programme covers strategic management frameworks such as the 7 S’s Framework, SWOT analysis, and Porter’s Five Forces for environmental and competitive assessment. Key topics like core competence, stakeholder analysis, and competitive advantage are discussed to provide a solid foundation in strategic decision-making. Strategic planning and implementation stages are also examined, with a focus on aligning strategy with business objectives.

modules.summary: This programme equips professionals with the tools to develop and implement effective strategies, enhancing their organization’s competitive advantage. Key focus areas include environmental analysis, strategic planning, and stakeholder management.

outcomes: Explain what is meant by strategy and strategic management
Appreciate the importance of strategic management
Strategy formulation, Types of Strategies, Deliberate and emergent strategies
Understanding the competitive Environment, environmental analysis, 7 S’s Framework
Examine SWOT and BCG matrix as tools and models available to analyze the environment
Examine Product Market Matrix, Life Cycle Analysis, Porter’s Five Force Framework and Value Chain Analysis as tools and models available to analyze the environment
Who is a stakeholder? Stakeholder analysis and relevant strategies
Explain ‘Mission’ and ‘Vision’ and provide some examples of mission statements
What is core competence? difference between core and general competence
Examine how an existing core competence can be evaluated
Explain what is meant by competition and competitive advantage
Why is it important for a firm to have some form of competitive advantage?
Define strategic planning, stages in the strategic planning cycle
Examine the various approaches to strategy evaluation
Examine the process of effective strategy implementation
Highlight the relationship between the strategy development process and implementation
